lci_dataset_description: PV panel foreground inventory using the bundled BONSAI background and EF3.1 elementary-flow identifiers. All 202 direct elementary exchanges are retained. The 52 of 177 original product-input rows without a BONSAI match (transport, water, wastewater, capital goods, glass tempering) remain excluded; several Chinese BONSAI producers (e.g. aluminium) lack electricity inputs.
